summary.text: Mike Berg is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 8 (home city listed as Bismarck), serving since 2025 per the legislature's member page; the page lists the role of Majority Caucus Leader.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Berg lists an occupation of Civil Engineer.
It lists education as BS, Mechanical Engineering, NDSU.
It also lists Director, American Water Works Association, ND American Council of Engineering Companies, Bismarck-Mandan Chamber and Church Council, Good Shepherd Lutheran.
Family is listed as: Married (Wendy); 2 children.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Berg's standing committee assignments as Appropriations and Appropriations - Human Resources Division.
